posts.title: Genworth — R70 Age Suit
posts.excerpt: Interactive R70 Age Suit infographic for genworth.com and the PRO Agent portal.
posts.content:
Custom AEM / JavaScript experience for Genworth Financial: an interactive R70 Age Suit infographic with hover targets for vision, hearing, arthritis, and muscle loss, plus help controls for showing, hiding, and explaining each hotspot.

Built while managing content for genworth.com and the PRO Agent portal on Adobe CQ5/AEM, including the Long Term Care responsive upgrade, Eloqua tagging, and SEO (Schema, OG meta, canonicals).
